23 @ 105 $ 15 % 6 # 29
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using **BODMAS RULE :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc3457babe125502573309d9bb752bc388ed87c831d68201676aa902653eca94.png] 

 
 

 **Symbol**
 @
 %
 $
 #
 
 

 **Mathematical Symbol**
 +
 × 
 ÷ 
 -
 
 

The given expression is : 23 @ 105 $ 15 % 6 # 29

After inserting the mathematical symbols in given expression is as follows : 23 + 105 ÷ 15 × 6 - 29

= 23 + __**105 ÷ 15**__ × 6 - 29

= 23 + __**7 × 6**__ - 29

= __**23 + 42**__ - 29

= __**65 - 29**__

= **36**

Hence, the correct answer is **"36".**

72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aacb9b5c9c0e66a9d27b184ff5f4793344022e762e948f5afcad76a2b1508286.png] 

Option 1) : − and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 - 18 ÷ 9 + 19 × 39 = 16

⇒ 72 - __**18 ÷ 9**__ + 19 × 39 = 16

⇒ 72 - 2 + __**19 × 39**__ = 16

⇒ __**72**__ - 2 __**+ 741**__ = 16

⇒ __**813 - 2**__ = 16

⇒ 811 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : + and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 + 18 ÷ 9 × 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 + __**18 ÷ 9**__ × 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 + __**2 × 19**__ - 39 = 16

⇒ __**72 + 38**__ - 39 = 16

⇒ __**110 - 39**__ = 16

⇒ 71 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : − and +

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ 72 × __**18 ÷ 9**__ - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ __**72 × 2**__ - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ __**144**__ - 19 __**+ 39**__ = 16

⇒ __**183 - 19**__ = 16

⇒ 164 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : ÷ and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 ÷ 18 × 9 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ __**72 ÷ 18**__ × 9 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ __**4 × 9**__ + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ __**36 + 19**__ - 39 = 16

⇒ __**55 - 39**__ = 16

⇒ **16 = 16**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and ×".**
